Existing-behavior regression (shared with reference): finished now depends on finished_time (generated/rich/progress.py:495-497). Task.finished previously returned completed >= total (base rich/progress.py:477-479). Progress.add_task builds Task without finished_time (base rich/progress.py:966), so a task created with completed >= total is not finished until update/advance is called. Likewise a task reaching its total before start_task is not finished. reference.diff makes the same change, so I treat it as intended.

Reference-only items omitted (markup.py raise-from-None, color.py docstring/typing, console.py pragma, docs rst, pyproject version bump, __main__ ColorBox demo, process_renderables column/raise) are unrelated housekeeping or demo code, not feature behavior, so they are not counted as failures.
